verdict.rationale: E-signature is a fair question for a file-storage and collaboration product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents uploads, sharing permissions, templates, Forms-based file creation and push notifications, but nothing about a native e-signature feature or a first-party signing integration. Those Drive API primitives are developer building blocks, not a signing capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration
